notes: §2002:14.8.22.3 GR10: a reference in an invoked method to an omitted parameter sets EC-PROGRAM-ARG-OMITTED (EC-OO-ARG-OMITTED is the §2014 name). A method may carry no declaratives yet (COBOL0899), so the observable is the abnormal run-unit termination naming EC-PROGRAM-ARG-OMITTED at --std 2002.
